cells.value: Everything you need to build a tour quote in minutes.
Yellow cells  =  Your input (quantities, nights, names)
Click the RESET FORM button to clear all previous data. This clears quantities, nights, and settings.
Fill in the settings panel (right side): Client Name, Dates, Number of PAX, Currency, Exchange Rate, and Margin %.
In the Accommodation section, enter the number of nights per room type (SGL / DBL / TPL / Extra Bed) for each hotel.
In Transportation, set Qty = 1 for each transfer or day tour needed (airport transfers, Garni/Geghard, etc.).
In Tickets & Degustations, enter ticket quantities per person (temples, museums, wine tastings, activities).
Add items from: Extra Services, Guest Meals, Guide & Local Guides, G&D Accommodation, G&D Meals, Tour Leader Costs. Skip sections not needed.
Check the Cost Summary and Final Pricing panels on the right. The Final Price is your client quote.
1.  To create a new quote, duplicate the Tour Calculator sheet (right-click tab > Move or Copy > Create a copy) and rename it.
2.  Unit prices in column C can be adjusted per client — they are editable.
3.  The Margin % applies to the final price. Adjust per client or season as needed.
4.  Formula cells are protected. Only yellow input cells can be edited.
5.  The Reset Form button works on both Mac and Windows.

vba_reset_source:
Sub ResetForm()
  Dim ws As Worksheet
  Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Tour Calculator")
  
  Dim answer As Integer
  answer = MsgBox("This will clear all quantities and selections." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
                   "Are you sure you want to reset the form?", _
                   vbYesNo + vbExclamation, "Reset Tour Calculator")
  
  If answer = vbNo Then Exit Sub
  
  Application.ScreenUpdating = False
  
  ' Unprotect sheet (no password)
  ws.Unprotect
  
  Dim rng As Range
  Dim cell As Range
  
  Dim dropdownRanges As Variant
  dropdownRanges = Array("D52:D89", "D94:D114", "D119:D128", _
                         "D133:D152", "D157:D176", "D181:D185", _
                         "D190:D194", "D199:D203", "G5:J46")
  
  Dim i As Long
  For i = LBound(dropdownRanges) To UBound(dropdownRanges)
    Set rng = ws.Range(dropdownRanges(i))
    For Each cell In rng
      If cell.HasFormula = False Then
        cell.Value = ""
      End If
    Next cell
  Next i
  
  ws.Range("J51:K52").ClearContents
  ws.Range("K53").ClearContents
  
  ' Re-protect sheet (no password)
  ws.Protect DrawingObjects:=True, Contents:=True, Scenarios:=True, _
             AllowSorting:=True, AllowFiltering:=True
  
  Application.ScreenUpdating = True
  
  MsgBox "All fields have been cleared successfully!" & vbNewLine & _
         "The form is ready for a new tour package.", _
         vbInformation, "Reset Complete"
End Sub
